scripts.check:emoji: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function scan(d){let found=false;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const p=path.join(d,f);if(fs.statSync(p).isDirectory()){if(scan(p))found=true;}else if(/\.(jsx?|tsx?|html|css)$/.test(f)){const content=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const matches=content.match(/[\u{1F300}-\u{1FAFF}\u{2600}-\u{27BF}\u{1F600}-\u{1F64F}\u{1F680}-\u{1F6FF}]/gu);if(matches){console.error('Emoji found in '+p+': '+matches.join(' '));found=true;}}}return found;}process.exit(scan('src')?1:0);"
